challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: I am willing to accept a more automated and governed approach to our data contracts, provided it does not interfere with the weekly leaflet planning cycle. The current manual review process is slow, and I see the value in reducing that friction for the team. However, if implementing full automation introduces any delay to the promotion calendar or risks missing a leaflet deadline, I will not support the change. I am prepared to give up the flexibility of the manual review process if the automated system can guarantee that our promotion weeks remain on schedule without any bottlenecks in the pipeline.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are prepared to give up the flexibility of the manual review process in exchange for an automated system, provided it guarantees schedule adherence.
